items.t: Starlink Mobile Reached 3M+ Kazakh Users in “Cellular Dead Zones” in Under Two Months. Bad News for AST SpaceMobile
items.sum: Key TakeawaysStarlink said more than 3 million Beeline Kazakhstan customers are using Starlink Mobile in cellular dead zones less than two months after launch. SpaceX is showing that a carrier partner can scale satellite phone service fast, while AST SpaceMobile still lacks the satellites it needs for continuous coverage.
